about: Golden vectors for the Campfire PWA Spark wasm module (see generator). Amounts are decimal strings; bytes are hex.

generator.rng: block i = SHA-256(SHA-256(utf8(rngLabel)) || LE64(i)); RAND_bytes takes bytes in order; rngBytes = bytes taken
generator.crossChecked: every vector also produced by pwa/spark/src/spark_wasm.cpp natively, byte for byte
